description: 한국수자원공사_상수도법정수질정보 조회 서비스 [drinking water supply] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국수자원공사. 본 데이터는 지방(지자체) 및 광역수도사업자가 생산, 관리하는 법정수질정보(월정수장)에 대한 수질 항목 정보를 조회할 수 있도록 지원합니다. 해당 자료는 먹는 물의 안전성을 보장하기 위해 법적으로 정해진 항목별 기준치와 관련 정보를 포함하며, 이용자는 각 수질 항목의 정의와 법정 기준을 확인할 수 있습니... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국수자원공사. Its tags are 상수도, 수질정보, 상수도법정수질, 미생물, 무기물질. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-08-27 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
